entries.sourceReference: Teen Titans (2003 animated series), Victor Stone/Cyborg. Genuine roster performer with sixteen newly generated poses; adaptation, not verified source frames. All sixteen full subjects visually inspected. Local cyan rings only for Cyborg, free-hand physical Kiryu combo, non-graphic silver/blue-white HF blade for Raiden and physical Kensuke for Laios. All transparent source seams pass. Wide 512x256 destination cells preserve weapon reach and body height without per-pose resizing.
